name: tag models
description:
1. Task: add capability tags (vision, image, coding, design, reasoning, etc.) to every model in `models_export.js`.
2. Extended the tag set with video, audio, speech, music, math, research, agentic, embedding, translation, and fast — capped at 6 tags per model.
3. Added `tags` arrays to all models in each provider's `price_list` (openai, gemini, claude, Deepseek) without touching any other field.
4. Added matching `tags` arrays to every entry in the `ai_models` array, aligned with each model's underlying provider model.
5. Delivered a full updated JSON export plus a tag glossary; noted `veo-3.1-generate-preview` also received the `video` tag.

messages.content:
Add tags to models with their capabilities and best use cases.
Tags:
 - vision
 - image (generates images)
 - coding (good for coding)
 - design (good for UI/UX designs)
 - reasoning (good for reasoning on a topic)
(add more tags you think can help user to decide which model to use for a task)

Models will have up to 6 tags

Tags in the price list example:
```
,
        {
          "model_name": "veo-3.1-generate-preview",
          "input_price_per_1k_tokens": 0,
          "output_price_per_1k_tokens": 0,
          "tags": ["image", "vision", "design"]
        }
```

Tags in the model definition (all models must have their tags):

```
{
      "name": "deepseek-flash",
      "model_type": "llm",
      "ai_provider": "Deepseek",
      "ai_model": "deepseek-flash",
      "settings": {
        "temperature": 0.7,
        "context_length": 2048,
        "merge_messages": false
      },
      "metadata": {},
      "url": "",
      "system": "",
      "prompt_template": "",
      "model_file": "# Modelfile for AI Model\nFROM base\n\nPARAMETER temperature 0.7\nPARAMETER context_length 2048\n\nSYSTEM You are a helpful assistant.",
      "max_tool_calls": null,
      "max_iterations": null,
      "tags": ["vision", "coding", "image"]
    }
```
